resources.string: Plays games made with RPG Maker MV from a folder on this device. Choose the folder that contains Game.exe or index.html.
File access is required to read game folders and to write save files next to them.
This folder cannot be opened directly. Choose a folder on internal storage or an SD card.
RPG Maker MZ games are not supported yet.
This is an RPG Maker XP/VX/VX Ace game. Try mkxp-z (mkxp-z.github.io) instead.
This is an RPG Maker 2000/2003 game. Try EasyRPG Player (easyrpg.org) instead.
No RPG Maker MV game was found in this folder.
